title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)

requirements.summary: Open to Virginia Tech undergraduates regardless of major.

requirements.title: How to pursue the minor
requirements.summary: Minor declarations begin with the August 2026 major/minor application review. The department permits adding classes without prerequisites from June 10, 2026; students must check prerequisites before enrolling. These administrative dates do not establish first instruction.

requirements.title: Engineering minor application
requirements.summary: AI is listed as a non-restricted engineering minor. Students submit the College of Engineering minor application during an application window; the page identifies availability from the August 2026 review.

requirements.title: Applicable curriculum source and catalog year
requirements.summary: The registrar directs catalog years 2024–25 onward to the University Catalog, while these legacy checksheets cover 2021–23 requirements. Confirm the applicable catalog year in DARS with an advisor. Historical checksheets do not verify this new minor’s current courses.
